question_en: What kinds of incidents does MSFT warn could damage its reputation and brands, according to its fiscal 2022 10-K risk factors?
question_vi: Theo phần rủi ro trong báo cáo 10-K năm tài chính 2022, MSFT cảnh báo những loại sự việc nào có thể làm tổn hại uy tín và thương hiệu của công ty?
reference_answer: Microsoft lists product safety or quality issues, its environmental impact and sustainability, supply chain practices and human rights record; plus new features, products, services or terms customers dislike, public scrutiny of its privacy, data practices or content decisions, and data security breaches, compliance failures or actions of partners or employees.
evidence_quotes: These include product safety or quality issues, our environmental impact and sustainability, supply chain practices, or human rights record.
The introduction of new features, products, services, or terms of service that customers, users, or partners do not like.
Public scrutiny of our decisions regarding user privacy, data practices, or content.
Data security breaches, compliance failures, or actions of partners or individual employees.

question_en: Which cost categories make up R&D spending at Alphabet (Q1 2026 10-Q) and NVIDIA (Q1 FY2027 10-Q)?
question_vi: Chi phí R&D của Alphabet (10-Q quý 1/2026) và NVIDIA (10-Q quý 1 năm tài chính 2027) gồm những nhóm chi phí nào?
reference_answer: Alphabet lists depreciation of its technical infrastructure, compensation for engineering and technical employees, other technical infrastructure operations costs (energy, equipment, network capacity) and third-party services fees. NVIDIA names compute and infrastructure (up 112%), compensation and benefits including stock-based compensation (up 31%), and engineering development materials (up 204%) as the categories behind its Q1 fiscal 2027 R&D increase.
evidence_quotes: depreciation expense, primarily related to our technical infrastructure;
employee compensation expenses for engineering and technical employees responsible for research and development related to our existing and new products and services;
other technical infrastructure operations costs, including energy, equipment, and network capacity costs; and
third-party services fees primarily relating to consulting and outsourced services in support of our engineering and product development efforts.

The increase in research and development expenses for the first quarter of fiscal year 2027 was primarily driven by a 112% increase in compute and infrastructure, a 31% increase in compensation and benefits
a 204% increase in engineering development materials for new product introductions.

question_en: In AAPL's fiscal 2021 10-K, what three things are its internal control policies over financial reporting meant to ensure?
question_vi: Trong báo cáo 10-K năm tài chính 2021, các chính sách kiểm soát nội bộ đối với báo cáo tài chính của AAPL nhằm đảm bảo ba điều gì?
reference_answer: Apple says its internal control policies and procedures (i) keep records that accurately and fairly reflect transactions and dispositions of assets, (ii) give reasonable assurance that transactions are recorded so GAAP financial statements can be prepared and that receipts and expenditures follow management and director authorizations, and (iii) give reasonable assurance of preventing or timely detecting unauthorized acquisition, use or disposition of assets that could materially affect the financial statements.
evidence_quotes: (i) pertain to the maintenance of records that, in reasonable detail, accurately and fairly reflect the transactions and dispositions of the Company’s assets;

(ii) provide reasonable assurance that transactions are recorded as necessary to permit preparation of financial statements in accordance with GAAP, and that the Company’s receipts and expenditures are being made only in accordance with authorizations of the Company’s management and directors; and

(iii) provide reasonable assurance regarding prevention or timely detection of unauthorized acquisition, use, or disposition of the Company’s assets that could have a material effect on the financial statements.

question_en: What did Amazon forecast for Q1 2024 net sales and operating income in its 2023 annual report, and what assumptions does that guidance rest on?
question_vi: Trong báo cáo thường niên 2023, Amazon dự báo doanh thu thuần và lợi nhuận hoạt động quý 1/2024 như thế nào, và dự báo đó dựa trên những giả định gì?
reference_answer: Amazon guided Q1 2024 net sales of $138.0–$143.5 billion (8%–13% growth over Q1 2023, including about a 40 basis point favorable FX impact) and operating income of $8.0–$12.0 billion versus $4.8 billion a year earlier, including about $0.9 billion lower depreciation from a longer server useful life; it assumes no additional acquisitions, restructurings or legal settlements.
evidence_quotes: Net sales are expected to be between $138.0 billion and $143.5 billion, or to grow between 8% and 13% compared with first quarter 2023.
Operating income is expected to be between $8.0 billion and $12.0 billion, compared with $4.8 billion in first quarter 2023.
This guidance assumes, among other things, that no additional business acquisitions, restructurings, or legal settlements are concluded.

question_en: In its Q3 fiscal 2022 10-Q, how did NVDA say the move to Ethereum 2.0 could hurt its GPU business?
question_vi: Trong báo cáo 10-Q quý 3 năm tài chính 2022, NVDA cho rằng việc Ethereum chuyển sang chuẩn 2.0 có thể ảnh hưởng xấu đến mảng GPU của họ như thế nào?
reference_answer: NVIDIA warned that the pending Ethereum 2.0 standard may reduce use of GPUs for Ethereum mining, increase aftermarket resales of its GPUs, affect GPU retail prices, raise product returns in the distribution channel, and reduce demand for its new GPUs.
evidence_quotes: the pending Ethereum 2.0 standard may decrease the usage of GPUs for Ethereum mining and may also create increased aftermarket resales of our GPUs, impact retail prices for our GPUs, increase returns of our products in the distribution channel, and may reduce demand for our new GPUs

question_en: What steps does MSFT follow when a cybersecurity incident hits, according to its fiscal 2025 10-K?
question_vi: Theo báo cáo 10-K năm tài chính 2025, MSFT xử lý một sự cố an ninh mạng qua những bước nào?
reference_answer: Microsoft uses incident response plans at company and product level: incidents are triaged for severity, then assessed to set a plan of record and trigger internal and external notification, disclosure and communication plans; engineering resources are mobilized to resolve them, followed by a comprehensive post-incident review.
evidence_quotes: Incidents are first triaged for severity, and then more deeply assessed to establish a plan of record and activate internal and external notification, disclosure, and communication plans, as applicable.
After the incident is resolved, a comprehensive post-incident review process is conducted.

question_en: In the 2021 shareholder letter filed with an April 2022 8-K, how did Amazon's workplace injury rates compare with warehousing and delivery peers?
question_vi: Trong thư gửi cổ đông năm 2021 (nộp kèm 8-K tháng 4/2022), tỷ lệ tai nạn lao động của Amazon so với các công ty cùng ngành kho bãi và giao hàng ra sao?
reference_answer: Amazon's recordable incident rate was slightly above the warehousing peer average (6.4 vs. 5.5) and slightly below the courier and delivery peer average (7.6 vs. 9.1), which it described as about average.
evidence_quotes: In the last U.S. public numbers, our recordable incident rates were a little higher than the average of our warehousing peers (6.4 vs. 5.5), and a little lower than the average of our courier and delivery peers (7.6 vs. 9.1).
